title: Strange Places v5.2
subtitle: 354K georeferenced phenomena: UFOs, bigfoot, meteorites, earthquakes, caves
description:
354,770 georeferenced mysterious phenomena from NASA, NOAA, USGS, BFRO, NUFORC, OpenStreetMap, the Megalithic Portal, and the Shadowlands Haunted Places Index. Every record comes from authoritative databases -- no synthetic data.

14 categories: Tornadoes (71K), Caves (70K), UFO Sightings (60K), Megalithic Sites (60K), Meteorites (32K), Ghost Towns (18K), Storms (14K), Haunted Places (9.7K), Thermal Springs (5K), Bigfoot (3.8K), Earthquakes (3.7K), Shipwrecks (3.6K), Fireballs (863), Volcanoes (170).

All real coordinates from government and authoritative sources. Global coverage.
